visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a light blue striped shirt, sits at a desk with a laptop and a smartphone. He initially smiles while looking at his phone, then sets it down to type on the laptop in a brightly lit bedroom with a pink curtain and a bookshelf. (2) He repeatedly finds himself distracted by the phone, picking it up despite his efforts to work. He expresses frustration, shaking his head and sighing. (3) The man begins throwing the phone away to various locations: first onto the bed behind him, then into the living room onto a blue sofa. He wears a determined expression while walking back to his desk. (4) He continues the cycle, throwing the phone into a hallway with wooden panels near an elevator, and finally down a flight of stairs. (5) In the final scene, he is sitting on the stairs, holding the phone and laughing at a video on the screen, showing a complete surrender to the distraction.
